verdictScope: Visual integration of seven desktop captures only; generated bust portraits remain partial prototypes.

steps: Open all seven actual post-fix screenshots at original resolution.
Compare each portrait panel to the archived preclip screenshot of the same UI region.
Check for foreign faces, source-cell fragments, clipped heads/visors, visible opaque backgrounds and overlap with names or combat controls.
Compare broad character/costume cues with the already-consulted official ME2 cover and ME3 page5 reference renders.
Hash all screenshots, the unchanged generated atlas, metadata and rendering sources.
protocol.captureQualification: PNG detail panels measure 326×221 because the locator screenshot includes the border; the portrait detail CSS height is 220px. No resolution or pixels were reconstructed.

observations: Miranda and Thane each show one isolated portrait. No adjacent Garrus or other face is visible.
Names remain legible; Shepard and every other ME2 roster identity retain initials.
Only Miranda is visible, centered inside the detail panel, with no Thane cell on the right.
Hair, face and upper white/dark costume remain readable. Soft source edges and the generated halo are retained.
Only Thane is visible. Neither Miranda nor Garrus appears in the detail.
Drell face, dark eyes and upper collar remain readable; the head is not cut by the panel.
Miranda and Thane combat cards each show only their own portrait, without neighboring fragments.
Names, health labels, bars, target labels and commands do not overlap their portrait boxes. Targets retain initials.
Garrus has an isolated thumbnail; no yellow/green Thane fragment remains on its left.
Shepard, Liara, James, EDI, Tali, Ashley and Kaidan retain initials and readable names.
Only Garrus is visible. Thane is absent from the left of the detail panel.
Turian facial plates, mandibles, visor, damage and blue upper armor remain readable, without cutting the head or visor.
The Garrus combat card shows a single isolated portrait with no Thane fragment.
Garrus name, health, bars, controls and target cards remain readable.

resolvedFindings.resolution: The render uses a nested source-cell SVG viewport with explicit width 512/height 1024 and overflow hidden. The source atlas pixels are unchanged.
resolvedFindings.visualResult: No neighboring identity or source-cell fragment is visible in any of the seven post-fix screenshots.

observed: The three intended identities remain recognizable in their large details.
Names, selected borders, health labels, bars, targets and controls remain readable without portrait overlap at the reviewed desktop viewport.
All three large portraits fit inside their panel without cutting the top of the head or visor.
Soft edges and colored source halos remain visible but do not form an obvious solid rectangular background.
Roster and combat thumbnails identify the characters, while their small scale does not support fine costume or likeness verification.

visualEvidence: ME2 roster and battle panels show Miranda/Thane only; Garrus ME3 is no longer visible via a neighboring atlas cell.
ME3 roster and battle panels show Garrus only; Thane ME2 is no longer visible via a neighboring atlas cell.
Generic Shepard and all other roster entries in the inspected panels remain initials.
identityAndContext.functionalExclusions: Freedom’s Progress, prologue, MEA, ME1 and other helper refusals are runner assertions. The seven reviewed images do not by themselves prove every excluded context.

observedCorrespondence: White patterned chest panel, pale collar and dark surrounding outfit.
referenceComparisons.qualification: Generated pose, face, hair volume, seams, fasteners and chest ornament are interpretations; the cover does not establish the hidden costume. Recognizability is not an exact-model likeness approval.

observedCorrespondence: Green/olive drell head with dark patches and dark eyes.
Dark high open collar with pale edging.
referenceComparisons.qualification: The generated frontal portrait reinterprets head reliefs, facial proportions and coat details. No exact pattern, anatomical mesh or full costume conformity certified.

observedCorrespondence: Turian plated head, mandibular silhouette, lateral blue visor and facial damage.
referenceComparisons.qualification: The official embedded screenshot is 512×256 including UI. Fine scar, visor, armor geometry and material correspondence cannot be certified from that resolution.

functionalEvidence.distinction: The earlier functional report passed but the independent visual review found neighboring pixels. The new positive visual verdict follows actual inspection of the seven post-fix screenshots, supported by the completed post-fix functional run; DOM attributes alone were not treated as visual proof.

limits: Desktop 1440×1000 only; no mobile or tablet visual review.
Panel screenshots do not establish whole-screen scroll behavior.
No keyboard, screen-reader, color-vision or accessibility conformance audit.
No full-body sprites, back views, walking, eight directions, firing cycles, alternate costumes or equipment-dependent appearance.
No exact game-model face, anatomical mesh, garment, texture, material, palette or 1:1 fidelity certification.
ME2 cover leaves parts of the costumes hidden; ME3 Garrus reference is 512×256 including interface.
Small roster/battle thumbnails cannot establish fine facial or costume fidelity.
Three generated busts remain Prototype partial art; no animation task is completed by this review.

functionalContextChecks.name: Three exact contextual bust portraits decode from the generated atlas and render in roster/battle UI; foreign works, prologues, ME1 and Shepard receive none
